items.content: Pointed offers a strategic twist to the news quiz format, testing not just players’ knowledge of the news but also their confidence in their answers. items.title: US Midterm Candidates Tap Rare Bipartisan Issue: Credit Card Rates
items.content: With control of Congress hanging on a number of razor-thin races, both Democrats and Republicans are seizing on voters’ frustrations with rising credit card debt to win over inflation-weary Americans.
items.contentSnippet: With control of Congress hanging on a number of razor-thin races, both Democrats and Republicans are seizing on voters’ frustrations with rising credit card debt to win over inflation-weary Americans.
items.creator: Aidan Williams

summaries.zh: 美国中期选举中，民主、共和两党候选人均聚焦信用卡利率问题，以此争取对通胀不满的选民。由于国会控制权争夺激烈，双方均利用民众对信用卡债务上涨的普遍不满，将其作为争取选票的关键议题。
summaries.en: US midterm candidates from both Democrats and Republicans are focusing on rising credit card rates as a bipartisan issue to appeal to voters frustrated by inflation. This shared concern is being used to gain support in razor-thin races for Congress.

items.title: EU’s Kallas Says Hosting Putin at G20 May Normalize War Crimes
items.content: Vladimir Putin’s possible attendance at the Group of 20 leaders’ summit in Florida in December would risk regularizing Russia’s return to international forums while its war in Ukraine continues, according to the European Union’s top diplomat Kaja Kallas.
items.contentSnippet: Vladimir Putin’s possible attendance at the Group of 20 leaders’ summit in Florida in December would risk regularizing Russia’s return to international forums while its war in Ukraine continues, according to the European Union’s top diplomat Kaja Kallas.
items.creator: Helene Durand

summaries.zh: 欧盟首席外交官卡娅·卡拉斯表示，如果普京可能参加12月在美国举行的二十国集团领导人峰会，这将使俄罗斯在乌克兰战争持续的情况下，有风险地常态化其重返国际论坛。
summaries.en: The EU's Kaja Kallas stated that Vladimir Putin's potential attendance at the G20 summit in December could normalize Russia's presence in international forums amid the ongoing war in Ukraine. This risk would undermine efforts to hold Russia accountable for war crimes.

items.title: Stadiums Rethink the Women’s Restroom
items.content: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Writer and Journalist Benton Graham explains how stadiums and arenas are redesigning restrooms as women’s sports grow and venues recognize that equal restroom space does not necessarily mean equal access. Speaking with host Lisa Mateo, Graham says newer venues are dedicating more restroom capacity to women, while upgrades at older stadiums can carry significant costs. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Writer and Journalist Benton Graham explains how stadiums and arenas are redesigning restrooms as women’s sports grow and venues recognize that equal restroom space does not necessarily mean equal access. Speaking with host Lisa Mateo, Graham says newer venues are dedicating more restroom capacity to women, while upgrades at older stadiums can carry significant costs. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 《 Bloomberg 週末專訪》記者本頓·格雷厄姆解釋，隨著女子體育興起，體育場館正重新設計女廁所。他說，新體育場將更多廁位分配給女性，而老體育場的升級成本顯著。格雷厄姆指出，平等的廁所空間不意味著平等的使用權。來源：Bloomberg。
summaries.en: Stadiums are redesigning restrooms to better accommodate women amid the growth of women’s sports, recognizing that equal restroom space doesn’t equate to equal access. Newer venues are dedicating more restroom capacity to women, while upgrades to older stadiums involve significant costs. The changes reflect a shift in venue planning to address gender disparities in facilities. (Word count: 50)

items.title: Haunted Attractions Help Revive Neighborhoods
items.content: Journalist Elizabeth Yuko tells Bloomberg This Weekend how haunted attractions are drawing visitors and investment to struggling neighborhoods, including Baltimore’s Old Town and former industrial districts in Kansas City and Salt Lake City. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Lisa Mateo, Yuko explains how haunted-house operators can become unlikely partners in urban revitalization by investing in infrastructure, attracting businesses and finding new uses for neglected properties. (Source: Bloomberg)

Speaking with hosts David Gura and Lisa Mateo, Yuko explains how haunted-house operators can become unlikely partners in urban revitalization by investing in infrastructure, attracting businesses and finding new uses for neglected properties. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 据彭博社报道，记者Elizabeth Yuko指出，鬼屋等恐怖景点正吸引游客和投资，帮助巴尔的摩老城等衰退社区复苏。她表示，这些经营者通过投资基础设施、吸引企业及改造废弃物业，成为城市复兴的意外助力。
summaries.en: Haunted attractions are revitalizing struggling neighborhoods by drawing visitors and investment, as reported by journalist Elizabeth Yuko for Bloomberg. Yuko highlights cases in Baltimore’s Old Town and former industrial districts in Kansas City and Salt Lake City. She explains that operators invest in infrastructure, attract businesses, and repurpose neglected properties, turning haunted houses into unlikely partners in urban revitalization. (98 words)

items.title: EU Foreign Policy Chief Warns Against Normalizing Russia
items.content: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Russia is escalating its war in Ukraine and is not serious about peace, criticizing Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov’s statements at the G20 foreign ministers’ meeting in Atlanta and warning against normalizing Moscow on the international stage. Speaking with host David Gura, Kallas also calls for a diplomatic solution to tensions with Iran and discusses efforts to deepen the EU’s relationship with Canada through greater cooperation on trade, energy and defense. (Source: Bloomberg)

Speaking with host David Gura, Kallas also calls for a diplomatic solution to tensions with Iran and discusses efforts to deepen the EU’s relationship with Canada through greater cooperation on trade, energy and defense. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 欧盟外交政策主管卡亚·卡拉斯在接受彭博社采访时警告，俄罗斯正加剧在乌克兰的战争，且无意寻求和平，批评了俄罗斯外长拉夫罗夫在二十国集团外长会议上的言论，并提醒国际社会切勿将俄罗斯正常化。她还呼吁通过外交途径解决与伊朗的紧张关系，并讨论了深化欧盟与加拿大在贸易、能源和防务领域合作的努力。（来源：彭博社）
summaries.en: EU Foreign Policy Chief Kaja Kallas warns against normalizing Russia, stating that Moscow is escalating the war in Ukraine and not serious about peace. She criticizes Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov’s statements at the G20 meeting in Atlanta. Kallas also calls for a diplomatic solution to tensions with Iran and discusses plans to deepen the EU’s cooperation with Canada in trade, energy, and defense. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: AI Enthusiasm Is Collapsing and Tech Earnings Just Made It Worse
items.content: The last two weeks were supposed to bring some clarity to a stock market wobbling on a series of risks, particularly doubts about heavy spending on artificial intelligence, as a series of technology giants reported their earnings.
items.contentSnippet: The last two weeks were supposed to bring some clarity to a stock market wobbling on a series of risks, particularly doubts about heavy spending on artificial intelligence, as a series of technology giants reported their earnings.
items.creator: Jeran Wittenstein and Ryan Vlastelica

summaries.zh: 近期科技巨头财报发布，市场本应从中获得关于人工智能投资风险的清晰答案，但市场波动依旧。连续两周的财报并未消除市场对人工智能高投入的疑虑，反而加剧了不确定性。AI热潮降温，科技股表现不佳，引发市场担忧。
summaries.en: AI enthusiasm is declining amid market concerns about heavy AI spending. Recent tech earnings reports have failed to provide clarity, exacerbating doubts and contributing to stock market instability. The situation highlights growing uncertainty about the sustainability of AI investments.

items.title: Senegal Lawmakers Reject Budget Again, Putting IMF Deal at Risk
items.content: Senegalese lawmakers have again rejected the government’s revised 2026 finance law, prolonging a standoff that threatens to delay approval of a crucial International Monetary Fund program.
items.contentSnippet: Senegalese lawmakers have again rejected the government’s revised 2026 finance law, prolonging a standoff that threatens to delay approval of a crucial International Monetary Fund program.

summaries.zh: 塞内加尔议员再次否决2026年财政法案，导致政府与国际货币基金组织的合作计划受阻。此举延长了双方僵局，可能延误关键IMF项目的批准。
summaries.en: Senegalese lawmakers rejected the government’s revised 2026 finance law for a second time, delaying a potential IMF program approval. The ongoing standoff jeopardizes the IMF deal, raising concerns about the country’s financial stability.

items.content: Russia’s government has extended a general ban on diesel exports by producers until the end of January while still allowing some volumes to flow to the global market.

items.content: As lawyers for Mercuria Energy Group presented the commodity giant’s case against the Baltic Exchange this week, a group of smartly dressed Norwegian businessmen listened intently to the arguments from the back of a packed London courtroom.

items.title: AI Policy Risks Loom Over Stock, Bond Traders Ahead of Midterms
items.content: Wall Street expects Democrats to win at least one of the houses of Congress in the US midterm elections on Tuesday, setting the stage for a potentially volatile ride in the stock and bond markets with artificial intelligence oversight, defense spending and crypto legislation on the table.

items.title: Chocolate Price Spook Families for Halloween
items.content: Halloween candy is getting more expensive as higher labor, energy and transportation costs continue to pressure food prices. Stew Leonard Jr., CEO of Stew Leonard’s, says bags of popular candy are up about 50 cents from last year, prompting some shoppers to trade down to cheaper options. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss how affordability is changing consumer behavior, and how both environmental and economic changes are impacting the business. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.en: Higher labor, energy, and transportation costs are driving up Halloween candy prices, with popular bags increasing by about 50 cents from last year. items.title: Crypto Hack Reignites Regulatory Debate
items.content: A $6 billion crypto hack is putting digital-asset security back in the spotlight. Former CFTC chairman J. Christopher Giancarlo, known as “CryptoDad”, argues the attack exposed vulnerabilities at an individual firm rather than a failure of underlying blockchain technology. He is also calling for the US to take a more aggressive approach to state-sponsored cyberattacks. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the fallout from the hack and why he believes prediction markets should be regulated federally by the CFTC rather than by individual states. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: A $6 billion crypto hack is putting digital-asset security back in the spotlight. Former CFTC chairman J. Christopher Giancarlo, known as “CryptoDad”, argues the attack exposed vulnerabilities at an individual firm rather than a failure of underlying blockchain technology. He is also calling for the US to take a more aggressive approach to state-sponsored cyberattacks. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the fallout from the hack and why he believes prediction markets should be regulated federally by the CFTC rather than by individual states. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 一宗6亿美元的加密货币黑客事件再次引发监管辩论。前CFTC主席J. Christopher Giancarlo（“加密货币之父”）认为，此次攻击暴露的是个别公司的漏洞，而非区块链技术本身的缺陷。他呼吁美国更积极地应对国家支持的网络攻击，并主张联邦CFTC应联邦监管加密货币市场，而非由各州分别监管。来源：彭博社。
summaries.en: A $6 billion crypto hack has highlighted digital-asset security concerns. Former CFTC chairman J. Christopher Giancarlo, known as "CryptoDad," attributes the attack to vulnerabilities at a specific firm, not blockchain technology itself. He advocates for stronger U.S. action against state-sponsored cyberattacks and suggests federal regulation, rather than state-level, for prediction markets overseen by the CFTC. The incident reignites debates about regulatory oversight in the crypto space. (98 words)

items.summary: 一宗6亿美元的加密货币黑客事件再次引发监管辩论。前CFTC主席J. Christopher Giancarlo（“加密货币之父”）认为，此次攻击暴露的是个别公司的漏洞，而非区块链技术本身的缺陷。他呼吁美国更积极地应对国家支持的网络攻击，并主张联邦CFTC应联邦监管加密货币市场，而非由各州分别监管。来源：彭博社。

items.title: PacSun CEO: Brands Mean a Lot to Young People Today
items.content: Brieane Olson, CEO of PacSun, says that the retailer’s core customer is 16 to 24, while it is also tracking differences between Gen Z and Gen Alpha. Drawing on a PacSun Youth Report conducted with GlobalData and surveying 6,000 young people, Olson said mental health ranks as their top priority. She cited PACSUN’s ongoing partnership with Selena Gomez and the Rare Impact Foundation as an example of collaborations intended to have lasting value for young customers. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close" on October 29, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: New Balance CEO Joe Preston on NYC Marathon Partnership
items.content: Joe Preston, New Balance President and CEO, discussed the company’s long-running partnership with the New York City Marathon, which he described as a key part of the brand. More than 300 New Balance associates are in the city for race week, including 200 retail staff at the Javits Center expo, where more than 100,000 visitors are expected over three days. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close" on October 29, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)
